title: Share Trading Policy

tiers.name: Restricted Persons
tiers.description: Directors, Officers and Employees of BKI Investment Company Limited and its Investment Manager, Contact Asset Management Pty Limited, and their associates. The defined term itself bundles associates in; the Policy does not separately name a distinct associates tier.

windows.end_anchor: 12:01am on the day after the release of the Company's Appendix 4D and half year results to the ASX
12:01am on the day after the release of the Company's Appendix 4E and full year results to the ASX

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board of BKI has the discretion to impose Blackout Periods at any point in time for any reason, established by a resolution of the Board. The Policy does not state whether Blackout Periods, once imposed, are announced or kept confidential.

rules.detail: 'BKI securities' is defined narrowly as shares, options and other securities issued by BKI, and 'dealing' as directly buying, selling or otherwise trading in BKI securities. An OTC put/call written by a bank is not issued by BKI, so it is arguably outside the Policy's own definitions altogether; derivatives are not named anywhere.
Hedging is not named or defined anywhere in the Policy.

Not named. To the extent a monetisation of the underlying BKI shares counts as 'otherwise trading in BKI securities', it must sit outside Prohibited Periods and requires notice to the Company Secretary or Chairman before entering, and to the Company Secretary once completed.
rules.evidence: Directly buying, selling, or otherwise trading in BKI securities ... notify the Company Secretary or Chairman of any intended dealings prior to entering into the transaction

rules.detail: Short selling is not named anywhere in the Policy.
Stock lending is not named anywhere in the Policy.
CFDs are not named, and 'BKI securities' being limited to instruments issued by BKI means a CFD referencing BKI shares is not obviously caught.
Margin lending is not named anywhere in the Policy.
Granting security, a charge, lien or pledge over BKI securities is not named, and the 'dealing' definition (buying, selling, or otherwise trading) does not obviously extend to encumbrance.
No provision addresses margin loans or any other secured financing arrangement in respect of BKI securities.

Absolute, unconditional ban on short-term dealing in BKI securities, stated independently of the Prohibited Period restrictions; no length is defined and no exception is listed for it, unlike the general Closed/Blackout Period restriction which has a notification path and an Exceptional Circumstances override.
rules.evidence: Restricted Persons are prohibited from engaging in short term dealing in BKI securities; ... never engage in short term dealing of the Company's securities

the transfer of securities already held by the Restricted Person into a superannuation fund or similar scheme where the Restricted Person is a beneficiary

An investment in, or trading in units of, a fund or other scheme (other than a scheme only investing in BKI securities) where the assets of the fund or other scheme are invested at the discretion of a third party

accepting an offer to participate in an employee securities plan
any such similar transaction determined by the Directors to be a passive dealing

exemption_authority: Chair of the BKI Board grants Exceptional Circumstances approval to deal during a Prohibited Period (severe financial hardship, Court Order compulsion, or other Chair-determined exceptional circumstance); the Chair of the BKI Audit and Risk Committee approves instead if the Chair is the applicant. The Board separately has unfettered discretion by resolution to impose Blackout Periods at any time for any reason.

bespoke_clauses.clause: 'BKI securities' means shares, options and other securities issued by BKI. Dealing ... [means] Directly buying, selling, or otherwise trading in BKI securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: An OTC put and call written by a bank are not securities issued by BKI, so on the Policy's own wording they may fall entirely outside 'dealing in BKI securities' and outside the Policy's restrictions, leaving only the general Corporations Act insider trading prohibition (which does not turn on the instrument's form) as an independent constraint.

bespoke_clauses.topic: no financing or hedging provisions at all
bespoke_clauses.clause: The Policy's Restrictions on Trading, Allowable Dealings, Excluded Trading and Exceptional Circumstances sections make no mention of hedging, derivatives, margin loans, security, encumbrance, short selling, stock lending or CFDs.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: There is no express prohibition and no clearance gate on granting security over BKI shares to a lender, so the loan leg of a funded collar is unaddressed either way; this silence should not be read as an unambiguous green light, and a forced sale on default would still need to avoid the insider trading and short-term dealing prohibitions that do apply.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Restricted Persons are prohibited from engaging in short term dealing in BKI securities; ... never engage in short term dealing of the Company's securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Unlike the Prohibited Period restriction, which has a notification path and an Exceptional Circumstances override, the short-term dealing ban is stated as an absolute rule with no defined length and no listed exception, so an early unwind or short-dated structure risks breaching it with no cure available.

bespoke_clauses.topic: light notification gate outside Prohibited Periods
bespoke_clauses.clause: notify the Company Secretary or Chairman of any intended dealings prior to entering into the transaction; notify the Company Secretary of completed dealings.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Outside Prohibited Periods, dealing in the shares themselves requires only notice, not approval or a right of refusal, a materially lighter gate than seen in most peer policies, though it applies to dealing in the shares rather than to derivatives or security as such.

summary: This Policy is narrowly drafted: 'BKI securities' means shares, options and other securities issued by BKI, and 'dealing' means directly buying, selling or otherwise trading in BKI securities; hedging, derivatives, margin lending, security/encumbrance, short selling, stock lending and CFDs are not mentioned anywhere. On the Policy's own wording, an OTC put and call written by a bank (not issued by BKI) and a loan secured by a pledge of the shares fall outside the defined restrictions altogether, leaving only the general Corporations Act insider trading prohibition as an independent constraint. If the arrangement is nonetheless treated as a dealing out of caution, the gate outside Closed/Blackout Periods is light: simple prior notice to the Company Secretary or Chairman and notice of completion, with no approval step; dealing timed within a Closed or Blackout Period instead needs the Chair's (or Audit & Risk Committee Chair's) written approval under the narrow Exceptional Circumstances process. The one hard stop that would apply regardless of how the structure is characterised is the absolute, undefined-length ban on short-term dealing in BKI securities, which has no listed exception, so tenor and unwind timing need care. Overall verdict: likely available given the Policy's silence on hedging and secured financing, subject only to notification (or Chair approval if timed inside a Prohibited Period) and avoiding any short-term dealing characterisation.
